verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev documents an official MCP server that lets AI assistants interact directly with Trigger.dev projects. It includes tools for conversing with chat agents from Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf and others, and a probe confirmed the MCP docs page exists. missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of the MCP server in use, detailed evidence of the full tool surface and auth/setup flow.
